title.english: The Place It Came Back From

pairs.target: sè lā méiyǒu bǎ cōng liúgěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Sela had not saved the scallions for him to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没有把葱留给他看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuī mén shí , tāng yǐjīng zài lú shàng fān zhe xì pào , qiè hǎo de cōng duī zài wǎn lǐ , zhī shèng chuāngtáishàng duǎnduǎn yìpái lǜ jiān .
pairs.english: When Tavi opened the door, the soup was bubbling gently on the stove, chopped scallions piled in a bowl, only short green tips left on the sill.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维推门时，汤已经在炉上翻着细泡，切好的葱堆在碗里，只剩窗台上短短一排绿尖。

pairs.target: tā shuō xìn shōudào dé zǎo , zài děng tā , cōng jiù lǎo le .
pairs.english: She said the letter had arrived early; waiting any longer for him would have made the scallions tough.
pairs.hanzi: 她说信收到得早，再等他，葱就老了。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài ménkǒu wén zhe tāng wèi , hūrán juéde huíxìn lǐ nà jù wánxiào xiě dé hěn hǎo .
pairs.english: Standing in the doorway smelling the soup, he suddenly thought the joke in his reply had been well written.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在门口闻着汤味，忽然觉得回信里那句玩笑写得很好。

pairs.target: zǎochē bǐ yùjì wǎn le yìdiǎn , shāndào yǒu báo shuāng , gǎnchē rén zǒudémàn .
pairs.english: The early cart had been a little late: a light frost on the mountain road had made the driver go slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 早车比预计晚了一点，山道有薄霜，赶车人走得慢。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bāo fàngxià , xiān bǎ pà wò tuōmǎi suāncài de qián lìng fàngdào zhuō jiǎo , cái qù xǐshǒu .
pairs.english: He put down his bag, set Pavo's money for pickled vegetables separately on a corner of the table, then washed his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他把包放下，先把帕沃托买酸菜的钱另放到桌角，才去洗手。

alignment.english: on a corner of the table

pairs.target: sè lā dīng zhe tā de xiùkǒu kàn , shuō hóngxiàn zhèhuí zǒngsuàn yòng duì le dìfāng .
pairs.english: Sela inspected his cuff and said the red thread was finally in the right place.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉盯着他的袖口看，说红线这回总算用对了地方。

alignment.english: was finally in the right place

pairs.target: tāmen chī guò dōngxī , tā cái jiǎng nài lěi huílái , jiǎng zhǐtiáo zěnyàng cóng tiěpiàn dǐxià guòqù .
pairs.english: Only after eating did he tell her Nerai had returned and how the paper had passed beneath the iron.
pairs.hanzi: 他们吃过东西，他才讲奈蕾回来，讲纸条怎样从铁片底下过去。

pairs.target: tā méi dài liànxí tiěpiàn , biàn ná kuàizi bǐhuà , sè lā tīngdǒng yíbàn , lìngyíbàn jiào tā mànxiē .
pairs.english: He had brought no practice plates, so he demonstrated with chopsticks. Sela understood half and asked him to slow down for the rest.
pairs.hanzi: 他没带练习铁片，便拿筷子比画，瑟拉听懂一半，另一半叫他慢些。

pairs.target: tā fāxiàn gěi tā jiǎng , bǐ gěi mǐlā jiǎng gèng nán , què bùxiǎng bǎ nán de dìfāng quánshěng diào .
pairs.english: Explaining to her was harder than explaining to Mira, he found, but he didn't want to leave out everything difficult.
pairs.hanzi: 他发现给她讲，比给米拉讲更难，却不想把难的地方全省掉。

pairs.target: bó yà láishí , dài zhe yìzhī bǔ le dǐ de lánzi , shuō xiàgèyuè nà bǐ qián yǐjīng suàn tuǒ , jīnrì bù cházhàng .
pairs.english: Boya arrived with a basket whose bottom had been patched, saying next month's money was settled and today there would be no accounting.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅来时，带着一只补了底的篮子，说下个月那笔钱已经算妥，今日不查账。

pairs.target: tā bǎ lánzi háigěi sè lā , wèn tāmen wǔhòu qùbuqù liào péng .
pairs.english: She returned the basket to Sela and asked whether they were going to the salvage shed that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 她把篮子还给瑟拉，问他们午后去不去料棚。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu jīn zǎo lái guò tā tānqián , shuō tiān nuǎn yìdiǎn jiù guòqù zuò .
pairs.english: Master Zhou had passed her stall that morning and said he would go sit there once it warmed a little.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅今早来过她摊前，说天暖一点就过去坐。

pairs.target: sè lā huànshàng ruǎnxié , shuō zìjǐ yě qù , lù búyòng pápō .
pairs.english: Sela changed into soft shoes, saying she would go too; the route involved no climbing.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉换上软鞋，说自己也去，路不用爬坡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng wèn tā xīgài , huà gāng kāitóu , tā yǐjīng shuō zǒudémàn jiù xíng , bié yílù wèn shíbiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi began to ask about her knees, but she was already saying they only needed to walk slowly, not ask ten times along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想问她膝盖，话刚开头，她已经说走得慢就行，别一路问十遍。

pairs.target: wǔhòu de xiè tái bǐ tā jìde de kōng .
pairs.english: The unloading platform was emptier that afternoon than he remembered.
pairs.hanzi: 午后的卸台比他记得的空。

pairs.target: jǐgēn jiù liáng duī zài qiángbiān , dìshàng liú zhe láihuí tuō guò de bái hén .
pairs.english: Old beams lay stacked against a wall, and pale drag marks crossed the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 几根旧梁堆在墙边，地上留着来回拖过的白痕。

pairs.target: liào péng ménkǒu zuò zhe yígè shòu lǎorén , shǒulǐ ná le bànjié tóngtào , zhèng gēn niánqīng gōngrén zhēng tā shìbushì liè le .
pairs.english: A thin old man sat at the shed entrance holding half a copper sleeve, arguing with a young worker over whether it was cracked.
pairs.hanzi: 料棚门口坐着一个瘦老人，手里拿了半截铜套，正跟年轻工人争它是不是裂了。

pairs.target: zhēng wán , tā bǎ tóngtào hái huíqù , shuō nádào liàng chù kàn , bié duì zhe tā de liǎn kàn .
pairs.english: After the argument he handed it back, saying to look in the light, not at his face.
pairs.hanzi: 争完，他把铜套还回去，说拿到亮处看，别对着他的脸看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng nà rén zǒukāi , bào le míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for the worker to leave, then gave his name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等那人走开，报了名字。

pairs.target: lǎorén tái yǎnkàn tā , xiān kàn liǎn , zài kàn shēnliàng , suíhòu jiào tāmen zuò .
pairs.english: The old man looked up, taking in his face and then his height, before inviting them to sit.
pairs.hanzi: 老人抬眼看他，先看脸，再看身量，随后叫他们坐。

pairs.target: sè lā méiyǒu tì tā kāikǒu , zhī bǎ dèngzǐ wǎng píngdì nuó le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Sela did not speak for Tavi; she only moved the stool onto level ground.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没有替他开口，只把凳子往平地挪了一点。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng wèn nà tái péngchē . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “I'd like to ask about the covered car,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “我想问那台篷车。”塔维说。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu diǎntóu , shuō bó yà jiǎng guò .
pairs.english: Master Zhou nodded, saying Boya had told him.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅点头，说博娅讲过。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shǒulǐ de huī pāidiào , wèn tǎ wéi yào cóng nǎ yíchù tīng .
pairs.english: He brushed dust from his hands and asked where Tavi wanted to begin.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手里的灰拍掉，问塔维要从哪一处听。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánxiān bèi hǎo de jǐjùhuà jǐ dào yìqǐ , zuìhòu zhī wèn tā cóng nǎlǐ lái .
pairs.english: The sentences Tavi had prepared jostled together; finally he asked only where it came from.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原先备好的几句话挤到一起，最后只问它从哪里来。

pairs.target: " yú wān de huí jiàn . " lǎorén shuō .
pairs.english: “Return freight from Elmbay,” the old man said.
pairs.hanzi: “榆湾的回件。”老人说。

pairs.target: nàge dìmíng hěn qīng , qīng dé bú xiàng tǎ wéi děng le zhèmejiǔ de dōngxī .
pairs.english: The place name sounded so light, unlike anything Tavi had waited so long for.
pairs.hanzi: 那个地名很轻，轻得不像塔维等了这么久的东西。

pairs.target: tā náchū běnzi , wèn shì nǎ liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: He took out his notebook and asked which two characters.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿出本子，问是哪两个字。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu búhuì xiě " yú ", biàn jiào tā xiān kōng zhe , shuō mùtou páng , yòubiān dé zhǎo rènzì de rén bǔ .
pairs.english: Master Zhou couldn't write the character for “elm,” so told him to leave a space for now: wood on the left, but someone literate would have to fill in the right.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅不会写“榆”，便叫他先空着，说木头旁，右边得找认字的人补。

pairs.target: sè lā wèn shìbushì tā shuō guò de hé xià nàge jiù zhuǎnyùnzhàn .
pairs.english: Sela asked if it was that old transfer station downriver he had mentioned.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉问是不是他说过的河下那个旧转运站。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu shuō shì , dàn zhàn yǒuméiyǒu gǎimíng , tā bù zhīdào , bùnéng ná shíjǐnián qián de jiàofǎ qù rèn jīntiān de ménpái .
pairs.english: Master Zhou said yes, but he didn't know whether the station had changed its name; a name from more than a decade ago couldn't identify today's doorplate.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅说是，但站有没有改名，他不知道，不能拿十几年前的叫法去认今天的门牌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de bǐ tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi's pen stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的笔停住。

pairs.target: tā jīhū yǐjīng kànjiàn yìjiān cóngméi jiàn guò de wūzi , wūlǐ yǒurén huítóu , děng tā jiào chū chēnghu .
pairs.english: He had almost seen a house he had never known, someone inside turning to wait for him to call them by a name.
pairs.hanzi: 他几乎已经看见一间从没见过的屋子，屋里有人回头，等他叫出称呼。

pairs.target: tīngjiàn " zhuǎnyùnzhàn ", nà wūzi yòu sàn le , zhī shèng zhǐ shàng yíkuài méiyǒu tián de kòngbái .
pairs.english: At “transfer station” the house dissolved again, leaving only an unfilled space on the page.
pairs.hanzi: 听见“转运站”，那屋子又散了，只剩纸上一块没有填的空白。

pairs.target: " shìcóng nàlǐ bǎ wǒ sònglái de ? "
pairs.english: “Was I sent here from there?”
pairs.hanzi: “是从那里把我送来的？”

pairs.target: zhōushīfu mànmàn yáotóu .
pairs.english: Master Zhou slowly shook his head.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅慢慢摇头。

pairs.target: " wǒ jiàn de shì chē ké de lái pái . rén dǎ nǎér lái , shuí sòng de , wǒ méi jiàn . "
pairs.english: “I saw the shell's origin tag. Where the person came from, who sent them, I didn't see.”
pairs.hanzi: “我见的是车壳的来牌。人打哪儿来，谁送的，我没见。”

pairs.target: tā jìde nà kuài pái , shìyīnwèi nà yìpī huí jiàn yào dān fàng , bùnéng hùnjìn pángbiān àn jīn shōu de sàn tiě .
pairs.english: He remembered the tag because that batch of return freight had to be kept separate from the loose iron beside it, which was bought by weight.
pairs.hanzi: 他记得那块牌，是因为那一批回件要单放，不能混进旁边按斤收的散铁。

pairs.target: tā tìrén chāoguò jǐkuài pái shàng de shù , shù zǎo wàng le , lái chù hái jìde .
pairs.english: He had copied the numbers from several tags for someone; the numbers were long forgotten, but he remembered the place.
pairs.hanzi: 他替人抄过几块牌上的数，数早忘了，来处还记得。

pairs.target: nà tái kézǐ méi lúnzhóu , xiàmiàn diàn zhe mù , gēn sè lā shuō de yíyàng .
pairs.english: The shell had no wheel axles and rested on timbers, just as Sela said.
pairs.hanzi: 那台壳子没轮轴，下面垫着木，跟瑟拉说的一样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn háizi shì zài shénme dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked where the child had been.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问孩子是在什么地方。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu yòng zhǐtou zài dìshàng huà le gè cháng kuàng , yòu zài yìtóu tiān chū yíkuài xiǎogé , shuō jiǎnxiū de rén cóng zhèlǐ jìnqù ,
pairs.english: Master Zhou drew a long rectangle on the ground with a finger, then added a little compartment at one end, saying maintenance workers entered here.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅用指头在地上画了个长框，又在一头添出一块小格，说检修的人从这里进去，

pairs.target: lǐtou yǒu yìcéng gé diàn , búshì zhuānghuò de dàdùzǐ .
pairs.english: There was an insulating lining inside; it was not the great belly used for cargo.
pairs.hanzi: 里头有一层隔垫，不是装货的大肚子。

pairs.target: bǎn biānkǎ zhe ní , tāmen qīng kāi cái qǐ dé dòng .
pairs.english: Mud had jammed the panel edge, and they had to clear it before they could pry it up.
pairs.hanzi: 板边卡着泥，他们清开才起得动。

pairs.target: " nǐ kànjiàn dǎkāi le ? "
pairs.english: “You saw it opened?”
pairs.hanzi: “你看见打开了？”

pairs.target: " kànjiàn le . wǒ dì de qiào dāo , búshì wǒ xiān shēnshǒu . "
pairs.english: “I did. I passed the pry blade. I wasn't the first to reach inside.”
pairs.hanzi: “看见了。我递的撬刀，不是我先伸手。”

pairs.target: tā bú jìde nàge rén de míngzì .
pairs.english: He did not remember that person's name.
pairs.hanzi: 他不记得那个人的名字。

pairs.target: dōu shì línshí còu de chāi liào gōng , yǒurén gānwán yìpī jiù zǒu .
pairs.english: They were casual dismantling crews, some leaving after a single batch.
pairs.hanzi: 都是临时凑的拆料工，有人干完一批就走。

pairs.target: lǐmiàn de dàyī dǎo jìde , xiùzǐ dié zài háizi tóu biān ,
pairs.english: He did remember the coat inside, its sleeves folded beside the child's head.
pairs.hanzi: 里面的大衣倒记得，袖子叠在孩子头边，

pairs.target: bānchūlái shí yǒurén pà sàn , lián zhe yíkuài tuō de .
pairs.english: When lifting the child out, someone supported the coat with him for fear it would come apart.
pairs.hanzi: 搬出来时有人怕散，连着一块托的。

pairs.target: sè lā de shǒu fàngzài xī shàng , méiyǒu dòng .
pairs.english: Sela's hand rested motionless on her knee.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉的手放在膝上，没有动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànkàn tā , tā diǎn le yíxiàtóu , shuō tā kànjiàn de jiùshì bào chūlái yǐhòu .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at her. She nodded once, saying she had seen only after he was carried out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看看她，她点了一下头，说她看见的就是抱出来以后。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén shuō dào tóng yíjiàn yīfu , shēngyīn bìng bù yíyàng , yīfu què dìyīcì xiàng yǒu le tā méi jiàn guò de lìngyímiàn .
pairs.english: The two voices describing the same coat were different, yet for the first time it seemed to have another side he had never seen.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人说到同一件衣服，声音并不一样，衣服却第一次像有了他没见过的另一面。

pairs.target: tā hái wèn le yǒuméiyǒu biéde dōngxī , yǒuméiyǒu zì , yǒuméiyǒu tīngjiàn rén lái zhǎo .
pairs.english: He also asked if there had been anything else, any writing, or anyone heard asking for him.
pairs.hanzi: 他还问了有没有别的东西，有没有字，有没有听见人来找。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu xiǎng dé hěn jiǔ , jǐcì zhāngzuǐ , yòu bì shàng , zuìhòu shuō zhèxiē bùgǎn dá .
pairs.english: Master Zhou thought for a long time, repeatedly opening his mouth and closing it again, then said he dared not answer those questions.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅想得很久，几次张嘴，又闭上，最后说这些不敢答。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu bǎ kòngbái dōu xiěchéng " méiyǒu ".
pairs.english: Tavi did not turn every blank into “nothing.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有把空白都写成“没有”。

pairs.target: fēng cóng péng hòu chuānguò lái , sè lā bǎ yījīn lǒng hǎo .
pairs.english: Wind passed through from behind the shed. Sela drew her coat together.
pairs.hanzi: 风从棚后穿过来，瑟拉把衣襟拢好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hé shàng běnzi , dào le xiè .
pairs.english: Tavi closed his notebook and thanked him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维合上本子，道了谢。

pairs.target: lǎorén jiàozhù tā , wèn rújīn zài xué shénme .
pairs.english: The old man called him back and asked what he was studying now.
pairs.hanzi: 老人叫住他，问如今在学什么。

pairs.target: tā shuō zài bái jiē xuégōng , cái xuéhuì ràng yìxiǎokuài tiě zài sōngshǒu yǐhòu zài děng yíhuìer .
pairs.english: He said he was at the White Steps academy and had just learned to make a small piece of iron wait a little after he let go.
pairs.hanzi: 他说在白阶学宫，才学会让一小块铁在松手以后再等一会儿。

pairs.target: zhōushīfu tīng wán , shuō nà tǐng hǎo , tā yì sōngshǒu , dōngxī búshì diào jiùshì gǔn , tǎ wéi hái néng jiào tā děngyīděng .
pairs.english: Master Zhou said that sounded good: when he let go, things either fell or rolled, but Tavi could make them wait.
pairs.hanzi: 周师傅听完，说那挺好，他一松手，东西不是掉就是滚，塔维还能叫它等一等。

pairs.target: sè lā xiào le , shuō tiě néng děng , tā zìjǐ dǎo děng búzhù fàn .
pairs.english: Sela laughed, saying the iron might wait but Tavi couldn't wait for a meal.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉笑了，说铁能等，他自己倒等不住饭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng biàn , dùzǐ què zài zhèshí xiǎng le yìshēng , sāngè rén dōu tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to argue, but his stomach growled just then, and all three heard it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想辩，肚子却在这时响了一声，三个人都听见了。

pairs.target: huíqù lùshang , tāmen rào jìn bó yà de tānzi , bǎ dìmíng bǔqí .
pairs.english: On the way home they stopped at Boya's stall to complete the place name.
pairs.hanzi: 回去路上，他们绕进博娅的摊子，把地名补齐。

pairs.target: tā zài " yú wān " hòumiàn tiān shàng " zhōushīfu suǒ jì lái pái ", ràng tǎ wéi zìjǐ zài chāo yíbiàn .
pairs.english: After “Elmbay” she added “origin tag as remembered by Master Zhou,” then had Tavi copy it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 她在“榆湾”后面添上“周师傅所记来牌”，让塔维自己再抄一遍。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā zhībuzhīdào nàlǐ , tā shuō zhī tīng guò jiùhuò dān , méi qùguò .
pairs.english: He asked if she knew the place. She said only from old freight sheets; she had never been.
pairs.hanzi: 他问她知不知道那里，她说只听过旧货单，没去过。

pairs.target: tiān hái méi hēi , tā yǐjīng zuò huíjiā lǐ de zhuōbiān .
pairs.english: Before dark he was already back at the table at home.
pairs.hanzi: 天还没黑，他已经坐回家里的桌边。

pairs.target: bāo lǐ yǒu pà wò tuōmǎi de suāncài , lúbiān yǒu sè lā liàng de xié , míngtiān cái huí xuégōng .
pairs.english: Pavo's pickled vegetables were in his bag, Sela's shoes drying by the stove; he would not return to the academy until tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 包里有帕沃托买的酸菜，炉边有瑟拉晾的鞋，明天才回学宫。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dìshàng nàge xiǎogé zhào jìyì huà zài běnzi lǐ , yòu zài pángbiān xiěxià jīntiān de rìqī .
pairs.english: He drew the little compartment from the ground sketch in his notebook from memory and wrote today's date beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 他把地上那个小格照记忆画在本子里，又在旁边写下今天的日期。

pairs.target: sè lā jiào tā bǎ wǎn dì lái .
pairs.english: Sela asked him to pass a bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉叫他把碗递来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ běnzi wǎng gān chù nuó , dì le wǎn , jiēzhe qù ná dìèrzhī .
pairs.english: He moved the notebook to a dry spot, handed her a bowl, and reached for the second.
pairs.hanzi: 他把本子往干处挪，递了碗，接着去拿第二只。

pairs.target: tāng lǐ cōng yǐjīng zhǔ ruǎn , chuāngtáishàng de lǜ jiān zài mù guāng lǐ jīhū kànbújiàn le .
pairs.english: The scallions had softened in the soup; the green tips on the windowsill were nearly invisible in the fading light.
pairs.hanzi: 汤里葱已经煮软，窗台上的绿尖在暮光里几乎看不见了。
